comparison.objective: Use an insulated stick to move a live-wire surrogate and plug off a walkway; the candidate adjusts a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Non-prehensile tool pushing of a deformable cable under a robot-contact prohibition, not threaded countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Cable clears the tape and plug reaches the parking zone without robot contact; candidate requires lock integrity and repeated actuation.
comparison.reason: Tool use is only a generic primitive; the safety constraint, mechanics, and outcome differ in both versions.
